parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Evaluate $\sin^{-1}(2/\sqrt7)$ to at least 1 d.p. [B1FT]. Guidance: $49.107^\circ$ to 3 d.p.; B1 can be implied by correct answers later; FT is on their $R$. SC: allow B1 for a correct alternative equation, e.g. $3\tan^2\theta-2\sqrt6\tan\theta+1=0$. Use a correct method to find a value of $\theta$ in the interval [M1]. Guidance: must get to $\theta$. Obtain an answer, e.g. $13.4^\circ$ [A1]. Guidance: accept correct over-specified answers $13.449\ldots$, $54.3425\ldots$. Obtain the second answer, e.g. $54.3^\circ$, and no extras in the given interval [A1]. Guidance: ignore answers outside the given interval. Total: 4.
